name: OrbitImages-TS-TW

frames.best_why: Every thumbnail sits on the full ellipse and the centre title is unobstructed; later frames have a cursor over the text.

tagline: Photos glide around a tilted ellipse that frames a centred headline.
summary: Eight small photos travel continuously around a slanted ellipse, passing behind a two-line title in the middle. The path can also be a circle, square, star, heart, wave or a custom curve.
appearance: A wide dark stage holds a thin grey ellipse drawn at a slight tilt, with eight square photo thumbnails spaced along it. Two lines of white type sit in the middle: a bold title above a smaller muted subtitle.
behaviour: The photos slide steadily around the fixed ellipse and never stop. Each thumbnail stays upright as it travels, while the central text stays still.
demo_content: Eight Unsplash nature and portrait photos; heading 'Orbit Images' with a one-line subtitle underneath.
search_phrases: photos circling around text in a loop
images moving along an elliptical path
hero section with images around a headline
gallery of thumbnails on a dark background
photographs travelling around a curved track
rotating image ring for landing page
animated image carousel around center text
use_when: A marketing hero needs motion and imagery around a headline without covering the copy.
avoid_when: On narrow screens the ellipse squeezes the thumbnails small, and the whole block is hidden from assistive tech.
customise: Images, orbit shape, radii, rotation, speed, item size, direction and path styling are props; the centre text is passed as a React node.
weight_why: Eight image nodes drift along offset paths in one infinite tween; no canvas or per-frame code.

a11y.note: The whole block is aria-hidden, so the photo alt text is never announced, and the endless loop ignores reduced-motion settings.

polish_why: Smooth steady motion and clean type; the thumbnails read very small on a wide empty stage.
title: OrbitImages
